d: Fears of renewed US strikes on Iran's nuclear facilities are raising alarm in Tehran, with reports that authorities are distributing iodine tablets to residents. Potassium iodide helps protect the thyroid gland from radioactive iodine exposure during a nuclear emergency. Meanwhile, Donald Trump has reportedly discussed further military options with US officials, fuelling tensions between Washington and Tehran. Is another confrontation looming? Watch this report for the latest developments in the growing US-Iran crisis and rising West Asia tensions.
